chunks: He said, informed me Abu Bakr Muhammad son of Umar al-Ji’abi he said: narrated to us Abu al-Abbas Ahmad son of Muhammad son of Sa’id al-Hamdani he said: narrated to us al-Hasan son of Ali son of al-Hasan he said: narrated to us Muhammad son of al-Husayn, from Muhammad son of Sinan, from Ubaid Allah al-Qasbani, from Abi Basir he said: I heard Aba Abd Allah Ja’far son of Muhammad upon them both peace

saying: Indeed our wilayah is the authority of Allah Mighty and Majestic which not was sent a prophet ever except with it, Indeed Allah exalted is His name presented our wilayah upon the heavens and the earth and the mountains and the cities but none accepted it an acceptance like the people of Kufa,
And indeed beside them is a grave no one comes to it distressed except Allah relieves Allah his grief, and answers his supplication, and returns him to his family joyful.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt and the people of Kufa?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) declares that the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt is divinely ordained, presented to all creation, but uniquely accepted by the people of Kufa. He praises the grave near them as a place of divine relief.
